title: The second walk of 2026-10-07: the rows that got no operation and stay in the queue
keys: Each queue row is keyed as it stood when the packets were built (stage-c7/work/entries.json). `group` is 1 for a row that the driver of the first walk skipped, 2 for a row that a decider of the first walk left with no category, and 3 for a row first seen after the first walk.
decidedBy: A blind product decider (Opus) for each row, or a correction of the session of stage c7. `leftBy` says which.

rowsOutsideTheWalk.note: These rows were never in the second walk. No file of this folder holds them one by one. Each kept the reason code of the first walk, and the codes are grouped here by their own words (build/stage-d.mjs, OUTSIDE_GROUPS). The review logs of the first walk hold each row.
